---
title: "Isochrones"
format: html
editor: visual
---

An **isochrone** is a line or polygon on a map that connects all points reachable from a specific starting location within a set amount of time

[Inspiration from Kyle Walker](https://walker-data.com/posts/accessibility-surface/)

### Libraries

```{r}
library(mapboxapi)
library(leaflet)
library(mapview)
```

### Create Isochrone

```{r}
isos <- mb_isochrone(
  location = "One Bowerman Dr, Beaverton, OR 97005",
  profile = "driving",
  time = 1:45
)
```

```{r}
mapview(isos, zcol = "time")
```

```{r}
library(sf)
library(fasterize)

isos_proj <- st_transform(isos, 32618)

template <- raster(isos_proj, resolution = 100)

iso_surface <- fasterize(isos_proj, template, field = "time", fun = "min")

iso_surface
pal <- colorNumeric("plasma", isos$time, na.color = "transparent")

nike_map <- leaflet() %>%
  addMapboxTiles(style_id = "light-v9",
                 username = "mapbox",
                 scaling_factor = "0.5x") %>%
  addRasterImage(iso_surface, colors = pal, opacity = 0.5) %>%
  addLegend(values = isos$time, pal = pal,
            title = "Drive-time from<br>Nike HQ")

nike_map
```

```{r}
nike_icon <- makeIcon(
  iconUrl = "https://nike.com/favicon.ico",
  iconWidth = 25,
  iconHeight = 25
)

nike_hq <- mb_geocode("One Bowerman Dr, Beaverton, OR 97005")

nike_map %>%
  addMarkers(lng = nike_hq[1], lat = nike_hq[2], icon = nike_icon)
```

### Lets go further

Question: Can we make an accessibility surfaces map for trauma centers, ER's, hospitals, fire stations etc. Maybe combine all of them into one shiny app. Let's strategise and design...

App design:

fire stations - mb_isochrone works well

ambulance -

shelters - Das me

cant go off base travel time in island wide emergency situation

hospitals, trauma centers, etc...

senior / etc transportation

swim, lifeguard response

-- shelters - Das me (and kyle ig) —

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(raster)
library(fasterize)
library(mapboxapi)
library(leaflet)
library(mapview)

# Oahu boundary (used to clip and to keep geocoding on-island)
oahu_bbox <- c(-158.30, 21.24, -157.63, 21.72)
oahu_box  <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(c(xmin = -158.30, ymin = 21.24,
                                 xmax = -157.63, ymax = 21.72), crs = 4326))

# 1. FEMA shelters (general population, medical, evacuation)
url <- paste0(
  "https://gis.fema.gov/arcgis/rest/services/NSS/FEMA_NSS/FeatureServer/5/query?",
  "where=state%3D%27HI%27&outFields=*&f=geojson"
)

fema <- st_read(url, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_filter(oahu_box) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    name = shelter_name,
    capacity = as.numeric(evacuation_capacity),
    capacity_after = as.numeric(post_impact_capacity),
    type = case_when(
      subfacility_code == "GENPOPSHEL" ~ "General population",
      subfacility_code == "MEDBNS" ~ "Medical / basic needs",
      subfacility_code %in% c("EMEREVAC", "EVAC") ~ "Emergency evacuation",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

# 2. Hurricane refuge areas (opened for Tropical Storm Lala, Aug 2026)
refuge_names <- c(
  "Blanche Pope Elementary School, Waimanalo, HI",
  "Castle High School, Kaneohe, HI",
  "Kahuku Elementary School, Kahuku, HI",
  "Kapolei High School, Kapolei, HI",
  "Mililani High School, Mililani, HI",
  "Moanalua High School, Honolulu, HI",
  "89-778 Haleakala Ave, Waianae, HI 96792",
  "Roosevelt High School, Honolulu, HI"
)

refuge <- lapply(refuge_names, mb_geocode,
                 search_within = oahu_bbox, output = "sf") %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  dplyr::transmute(name = refuge_names,
                   capacity = NA_real_, capacity_after = NA_real_,
                   type = "Hurricane refuge area")

# 3. Combine and clip to Oahu
shelters <- bind_rows(fema, refuge) %>%
  st_filter(oahu_box)

# Checks
table(shelters$type)
nrow(shelters)                       # should be 419
nrow(distinct(shelters, geometry))   # unique locations

mapview(shelters, zcol = "type", map.types = "OpenStreetMap")
```

```{r}

dir.create("isos_parts", showWarnings = FALSE)
batches <- split(seq_len(nrow(shelters_unique)),
                 ceiling(seq_len(nrow(shelters_unique)) / 50))

for (b in seq_along(batches)) {
  part_file <- paste0("isos_parts/part_", b, ".rds")
  if (file.exists(part_file)) next
  
  part <- lapply(batches[[b]], function(i) {
    Sys.sleep(0.5)
    mb_isochrone(shelters_unique[i, ], profile = "driving",
                 time = c(5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30))
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  
  saveRDS(part, part_file)
  message("Batch ", b, " of ", length(batches), " done")
}

isos_all <- list.files("isos_parts", full.names = TRUE) %>%
  lapply(readRDS) %>%
  bind_rows()
```

```{r}
  arrange(type, name) %>%
```


```{r}
get_isos <- function(pts, profile) {
  folder <- paste0("isos_", profile)
  dir.create(folder, showWarnings = FALSE)
  batches <- split(seq_len(nrow(pts)), ceiling(seq_len(nrow(pts)) / 50))
  
  for (b in seq_along(batches)) {
    part_file <- file.path(folder, paste0("part_", b, ".rds"))
    if (file.exists(part_file)) next
    part <- lapply(batches[[b]], function(i) {
      Sys.sleep(0.5)
      mb_isochrone(pts[i, ], profile = profile,
                   time = c(5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30))
    }) %>% bind_rows()
    saveRDS(part, part_file)
    message(profile, ": batch ", b, " of ", length(batches), " done")
  }
  
  list.files(folder, full.names = TRUE) %>% lapply(readRDS) %>% bind_rows()
}

drive_isos <- get_isos(shelters_unique, "driving")
walk_isos  <- get_isos(shelters_unique, "walking")
```

```{r}
drive_proj <- st_transform(drive_isos, 32604)
walk_proj  <- st_transform(walk_isos, 32604)

template <- raster(drive_proj, resolution = 100)

drive_surface <- fasterize(drive_proj, template, field = "time", fun = "min")
walk_surface  <- fasterize(walk_proj,  template, field = "time", fun = "min")
```

```{r}
# install.packages("leafem") if needed
library(leafem)

pal <- colorNumeric("plasma", c(5, 30), na.color = "transparent")

shelter_map <- leaflet() %>%
  addMapboxTiles(style_id = "light-v9", username = "mapbox",
                 scaling_factor = "0.5x") %>%
  addRasterImage(drive_surface, colors = pal, opacity = 0.5,
                 group = "Driving", layerId = "Driving") %>%
  addRasterImage(walk_surface, colors = pal, opacity = 0.5,
                 group = "Walking", layerId = "Walking") %>%
  addImageQuery(drive_surface, layerId = "Driving", group = "Driving",
                type = "mousemove", digits = 0, prefix = "Minutes to shelter") %>%
  addImageQuery(walk_surface, layerId = "Walking", group = "Walking",
                type = "mousemove", digits = 0, prefix = "Minutes to shelter") %>%
  addCircleMarkers(data = shelters_unique, radius = 3, color = "black",
                   weight = 1, fillColor = "white", fillOpacity = 1,
                   label = ~paste0(name, " (", type, ")")) %>%
  addLayersControl(baseGroups = c("Driving", "Walking"),
                   options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)) %>%
  addLegend(values = c(5, 30), pal = pal,
            title = "Minutes to<br>nearest shelter")

shelter_map
```
